claimLedger.claim: Cycle change often first; lists flushes, sleep, mood, vaginal, UTI, other symptoms; menopause after 12 months without period; postmenopausal bleeding needs review; contraception intervals after final period.
claimLedger.sourceSection: NHS · Symptoms of menopause and perimenopause · Page last reviewed: 19 May 2026
claimLedger.limitations: UK average menopause age; ethnic variation noted on page.

claimLedger.claim: Age ≥45: identify perimenopause from vasomotor symptoms + cycle change without lab tests; do not use AMH/oestradiol/AFC etc.; limited FSH use under 45.
claimLedger.sourceSection: NICE · Menopause: identification and management (NG23) · Updated recommendations including 2024 (fetched 2026)
claimLedger.limitations: UK guideline; premature ovarian insufficiency pathways differ under 40.
